phase_name: Red regression cases for the out-of-repository class

objectives.description: T15 - absolute path INSIDE repo still commits
T16 - in-repo leaf symlink to outside target is NOT dropped
T17 - path THROUGH in-repo symlinked directory is dropped as out-of-repository
T18 - every positive pathspec out-of-repository -> V3 refusal exit 2
Run suite pre-fix, record T14/T17/T18 FAIL, T15/T16 PASS, T1-T13/X1-X8/W1-W4 PASS
objectives.note: Confirmed: 49 passed, 3 failed (T14, T17, T18) against the unmodified script. Non-vacuity verified: T14/T17/T18 fail on content/message assertions, not just exit code (T18 matched rc=2 pre-fix too, but via the WRONG message -- V7 'genuinely unstaged', not V3 'zero positive pathspec entries remain' -- so the message-text assertion correctly fails pre-fix).

approaches_tried.approach: T16 asserting rc=0 exactly for an in-repo leaf symlink pointing outside the repo
approaches_tried.reason: Discovered a pre-existing, orthogonal defect: V8's pre-commit intent snapshot uses `git hash-object` which FOLLOWS a symlink and hashes the pointed-to file's content, while the blob git actually commits for a symlink is the raw target-path string. The two never match, so V8 unconditionally reports a false 'present with different content' mismatch (exit 5) for EVERY symlink this script commits, in-repo or out-of-repo target alike -- verified by reproducing it against a symlink pointing to an IN-REPO target. Reworked T16 to accept rc 0 OR 5 and assert on the narrower invariant this case actually needs to pin (not dropped as out-of-repository, HEAD+1, symlink present in the commit).

deviations.description: W4's existing fixture used an absolute /etc/passwd pathspec as its 'genuine add failure' mechanism
deviations.reason: Verified empirically that /etc/passwd would be silently reclassified as out-of-repository by the V9 gate landing in Phase 2 and dropped BEFORE git add, flipping W4's outcome from refuse-to-commit (exit 2) to commit-with-warning (exit 6) and defeating its purpose as a safety case. Replaced with an in-repo permission-denied file (chmod 000), verified to produce the identical rc=2/'genuinely unstaged' outcome today and to remain unaffected by V9 (its parent directory never resolves outside PROJECT_ROOT).
deviations.annotation: N/A -- W4 predates this plan's own checklist; not a plan task item, but recorded here since it is an existing-suite fixture change made during this phase.
